title: Software Engineer, Intern (Summer 2027) - US
content: <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. to be considered. DoorDash does not sponsor work visas for this position.</p><h2>Required Qualifications</h2><ul><li>You are pursuing a B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field and graduating between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028.</li><li>Experience with Python, Java, AWS, and SQL is required.</li></ul><h2>Preferred but not required</h2><ul><li>At least one prior project using Linux and Git.</li></ul>
